subject: Marketplace addendum: billing & invoice routing playbook
messages:
From: Jessica Nguyen <account_ops@orbitcloud.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace addendum: billing & invoice routing questions

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We're ready to move forward with the Marketplace/Reseller addendum but have a few open items on billing and routing that will affect our finance setup and the order form. High level questions:

1) Pass-through vs Redwood invoicing: our finance team prefers to invoice customers directly (pass-through) so we can apply our own margin and tax handling. Can you confirm whether Redwood will:
   - (A) allow Partner to invoice end customers for Redwood usage (partner-issued invoices), or
   - (B) require Redwood to invoice end customers and remit partner revenue via settlement?

2) Tax & withholding: for US customers we need clarity on who is responsible for sales tax/VAT collection and whether Redwood can provide VAT-qualified invoices for EU accounts.

3) Order form alignment: we need to ensure the Marketplace addendum maps cleanly to the MSA/Order Form (especially discount tiers and seat/commit terms). Any redline we should look at?

I've attached a short PDF with our questions and suggested language snippets (OrbitCloud_Questions.pdf). Would a 30-minute working session next week work to walk through redlines?

Cheers,
Jessica Nguyen\Director, Partner Finance\OrbitCloud

---
Attachment: OrbitCloud_Questions.pdf (2 pages, list of suggested clauses)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Nguyen <account_ops@orbitcloud.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum: billing & invoice routing questions

Jessica — thanks for the clear note and for attaching the snippets. Looping in Marcus (legal) and Vanessa (partnership ops) to scope the implementation work. Quick summary / proposed next steps from Redwood:

Summary:
- Redwood supports both patterns but prefers partner-invoicing only where the partner can accept and reconcile marketplace usage reports; otherwise Redwood can invoice end-customers and provide settlement statements.
- We need specific tax forms (W-9 for US, VAT registration for EU) and a billing integration (SFTP or API push) for pass-through.

Proposed next steps:
1) Marcus to provide redline language options for the addendum (partner-invoicing vs Redwood-co-bill).
2) Vanessa to outline operational checklist and timing for onboarding partner invoicing flows.
3) Quick 30-min call to agree final approach and capture any Order Form changes (discounts/commitments).

I've attached our working draft of the Marketplace Addendum with placeholders where we think the pass-through toggle should live (RN-Marketplace-Addendum-Draft.docx). Marcus/Vanessa — can you review and comment before Monday?

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Lauren Bishop\Head of Partnerships\Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: RN-Marketplace-Addendum-Draft.docx (redline-ready draft)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jessica Nguyen <account_ops@orbitcloud.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 20:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum: billing & invoice routing questions

Lauren / Jessica — quick legal take after a first pass on the draft. I put suggested alternative language into RN_redlines_v1.docx (attached). Main points:

1) Pass-through clause (two options) — choose one:
   Option A (Partner-issued invoices - pass-through):
   - "Partner shall invoice End Customers for Redwood usage arising from listings on Partner's marketplace. Partner is solely responsible for collecting payment, remitting any applicable taxes, and issuing invoices that meet local tax requirements. Redwood will provide monthly usage statements and reasonable cooperation to support Partner's invoicing and tax compliance."

   Option B (Redwood invoices End Customers):
   - "Redwood shall invoice End Customers for Services. Partner will receive settlement statements and payments according to the Settlement Schedule in Exhibit B. Partner remains responsible for applicable taxes on amounts paid to Partner under this Agreement."

2) Tax / VAT wording: require Partner to provide valid tax registration numbers (VAT/GST) and to confirm tax handling per region. If Partner requests Redwood to supply VAT-qualified invoices, we need to restrict to markets where Redwood has invoicing capability.

3) Order Form mapping: add a table in the Order Form that explicitly maps Marketplace SKUs to Order Form line items and shows which party issues the invoice. This prevents ambiguity when discounts or seat-based commits apply.

Open questions for OrbitCloud:
- Do you require that Redwood add Partner margins to invoice line items (i.e., show both Redwood usage and Partner markup)?
- Will OrbitCloud accept Redwood-provided usage reports via SFTP or do you need API push?

I'll highlight these as redline comments. If you want, I can pre-draft an Exhibit B (Settlement & Invoicing) that covers both flows.

Marcus Lin\Counsel, Contracts & Partnerships\Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: RN_redlines_v1.docx (legal redlines and two drafting options)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Jessica Nguyen <account_ops@orbitcloud.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace addendum: billing & invoice routing questions

Team / Jessica — operational notes from the partnerships & revenue ops side. If OrbitCloud wants partner-issued invoices (pass-through), operational requirements include:

- Reporting: daily or monthly usage files (CSV) with invoice-ready line items; preferred delivery via SFTP or secure API.
- Reconciliation: a settlement report schema (line-item token, usage quantity, billed amount, discounts).
- Tax docs: W-9 (US) or VAT registration number (EU). If partner will handle VAT collection, we need confirmation in writing and examples of sample invoices.
- Cutover timing: recommend a 30-day lead time for integration + one end-to-end billing reconciliation test.
- Marketplace listing: we need to determine whether the Partner wants Redwood to surface the Partner price or Redwood's net price on the marketplace tile (affects how discounts display).

I've attached a billing-integration-checklist that lays out data fields we will need and the recommended SFTP schema. If we go with Redwood-invoices-End-Customers (Option B), ops is simpler but settlement cadence and margin splits need to be locked in the Order Form.

Action items:
- OrbitCloud: confirm preferred flow (Partner invoices vs Redwood invoices) and provide sample invoice PDF and preferred integration method.
- Lauren / Marcus: decide which redline option we should propose to OrbitCloud for the initial contracted path.

Thanks — happy to run the integration call once we pick an option.

Vanessa Ortiz\Sr. Partnerships Manager\Redwood Inference

---

- VAT registration numbers for EU customers and a W-9 for our US entity (will email the forms).
- Sample invoice template and our preferred markup display (we show Redwood usage + our margin line item).
- We can accept SFTP-delivered usage CSVs; we'll plan for a 30-day integration window and one reconciliation test.

Let's do the 30-minute working session on Wednesday 10:00am PT if that works for your team. I'll send a calendar invite.
